title: Crash using `isinstance` + `super` due to Astroid

labels.name: Crash 💥
labels.description: A bug that makes pylint crash

labels.name: Needs astroid update
labels.description: Needs an astroid update (probably a release too) before being mergable

body:
### Bug description

When parsing the following ``a.py``:

```python
class A:
    def __init__(self):
        if not isinstance(super(), float):
            pass

```

there is a crash. Note however that this snippet is fine:

```python
class A:
    def __init__(self):
        if isinstance(super(), float):
            pass

```
with `not` removed. Also I believe it's nothing to do with `float`: you can replace this with a custom class, or another built-in.


### Command used

```shell
pylint a.py
```
